lines.zh: 我走得很慢，蹄子踩空一格。
lines.en: I walk slow; one hoof lands on nothing.
The black-and-white patches jitter on my back.

lines.zh: 我脖子上的铃响错了拍子。
lines.en: The bell on my neck rings off-beat.
I drag myself across the grass.
The grass turns grey where I pass.

lines.zh: 我的体重好像少了一半。
lines.en: I seem to weigh half what I should.
I take a step and my body lags half a block.
My shadow walks ahead of me.
I lower my head for grass to chew.

lines.zh: 蹄印是四个，又变成三个。
lines.en: Four hoof prints, then three.

lines.zh: 我绕开围栏，围栏也在动。
lines.en: I skirt the fence; the fence is moving too.

lines.zh: 我走得很稳，只是地方不对。
lines.en: My walk is steady; only the place is wrong.

lines.zh: 风一吹，我身上的斑纹换了位。
lines.en: A breeze rearranges my patches.

lines.zh: 我停在栅栏边，栅栏少了一根。
lines.en: I stop at the fence; a rail is missing.

lines.zh: 身后拖着一串模糊的脚印。
lines.en: A blurred line of prints trails behind me.
I moo, and the sound arrives before me.
I stand, tail swinging slowly.
One horn is simply absent.
I look at the barn; the barn shivers.
The grass in my mouth has no taste.

lines.zh: 我在反刍，但胃里是空的。
lines.en: I chew the cud, but my stomach is empty.
Frost comes off my nose.
I'm counting my own legs.
There's static in my ears.

lines.zh: 地上有一块黑，我踩不到。
lines.en: There's a black patch I can't step on.
The bell on my neck is silent.
A strip of my hide slides off.
The patches on my back are changing colour.

lines.zh: 我晃了晃头，虫子飞走了。
lines.en: I shake my head and flies leave.
The cattle shed flickers in the distance.

lines.zh: 我呼出一口气，它没有形状。
lines.en: I breathe out, and the breath has no shape.

lines.zh: 你的轮廓在我眼里一直闪。
lines.en: Your outline never stops flickering in my eyes.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，脖子响了一下。
lines.en: I lift my head; my neck clicks.
The ground where you stand is swaying.
Too much white shows in my eyes.
Not too close; pieces of me come off.
Milking? I'm not sure I still do that.

lines.zh: 我朝你走了一步，又退回去。
lines.en: I take a step toward you, then back.
Your shadow sticks to me.
I've smelled you; it's a stale smell.
I low, a long one.
The wall behind you has no texture.
I lower my head to look at your feet.

lines.zh: 你的手很干净，我不敢碰。
lines.en: Your hands are clean; I daren't touch them.

lines.zh: 我一直在看你，只是眼睛不对。
lines.en: I've been watching you, just not with my eyes.
The hide tears, but nothing bleeds.
I shake my head; the bell clatters.
I stand and slowly recover.
It hurts, but I won't run.
A little more of me falls away.
My breathing is loud.
My horns are numb from the blow.
I stare at you and don't retreat.
That's the smell of wheat.
I'll come, a little crooked.
Is the grass in your hand green?

lines.zh: 草在我的嘴里变成方块。
lines.en: The grass turns into blocks inside my mouth.
Let me sniff; don't take it away.
I chew twice and can't swallow.
A little closer and I can reach.
The bell rings; that's me moving.
I've forgotten what I was doing.
The grass is grey in my mouth.
I still want it.
Open your palm and I'll come.
This mouthful of grass tastes like iron.
This mouthful quiets me.
The smell on you is warm.
You bump into me and I sway.

lines.zh: 我这一块被挤得凹进去。
lines.en: This part of me gets pushed in.
Don't shove; my legs misalign easily.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，闷响一声。
lines.en: We collide with a dull knock.
Your hand goes through my ribs.
I step back; my hoof print is faint.
The bell rings once, and long.
A bit of me falls off.
This ground can't take my standing.

lines.zh: 我的同伴背上少了一块。
lines.en: My herdmate is missing a patch on her back.
Her low is off-pitch too.
I lick her neck.

lines.zh: 小牛在远处，形状不太对。
lines.en: The calf is far off, shaped a bit wrong.
The grass we share has no taste.
She leans in; I shift aside.

lines.zh: 我们两个的影子对不上。
lines.en: Our two shadows don't match up.
She's quiet; so am I.
We look the same way.
Something fell in the grass.
This is hard; I can't bite it.
It's cold in my mouth.
I push it toward my herdmate.
Carrying it, my bell rings too.
Was this cloth red?
It smells of iron, not grass.

lines.zh: 地上的东西，都带着坏掉的味道。
lines.en: Everything on the ground tastes broken.
I fix on that patch of shadow.
It's not quite the same as grass.
I lower my head, horns forward.
The bell rings wrong.
I take one step that way.
I smell it, right there.
The patches on my back go all black.
The grass there is sinking.
I'm going over.
I follow it at a slow walk.
My prints follow it along.
I hear breathing ahead.
It goes behind the fence.
I knock a post aside.
My horn sticks in a tree.
I pull free and keep going.
It hasn't gone far.
Its smell is on the ground.
I quicken my pace.
I lower my head and ram it.
My front hooves come down.
The hit sends it flying.
The impact sounds muffled.
I wrench my head and pull the horn free.
It rolls half a turn on the ground.
I pin it, breathing hard.
My horns feel warm.
It tries to run; I block.
I ram a second time.
The shed door opens by itself.
The fog lifts and I stand perfectly still.
A patch of the field has lost its colour.
The bell rings once; no one touched it.
My hoof lands on nothing.
It's unnaturally quiet.
The patches on me jump about.
A smell: rotting grass.
I low; the echo is slow.

lines.zh: 我甩了甩尾巴，飞虫散了。
lines.en: I swat my tail and the flies scatter.
I settle and stare at the fence.
This pasture is different today.

lines.zh: 火一烧，我的斑纹就冒黑烟。
lines.en: Fire burns and my patches smoke black.

lines.zh: 摔下去时蹄子先着地，错开一格。
lines.en: I land hoof-first, one block off.

lines.zh: 水灌进鼻子，我叫不出声。
lines.en: Water fills my nose; I can't low.

lines.zh: 炸响一声，我身上少了半边轮廓。
lines.en: A bang, and half my outline is gone.

lines.zh: 看不见的东西绕住我的脖子。
lines.en: Something unseen loops around my neck.
Hunger makes even standing unsteady.

lines.zh: 雷打在我背上，我全身发白。
lines.en: Lightning hits my back and I go white.

lines.zh: 没有草地了，我一直往下。
lines.en: No grass left; I keep falling.
